responsibility: Verifies the JSON diagnostic emitter’s span serialization by constructing diagnostics against synthetic source files and asserting that emitted byte offsets, line numbers, and columns match expected positions across BOM, LF, and CRLF newline cases.
same_name_distinction: Unlike the crate-root `tests.rs`, which validates Fluent diagnostic translation and fallback/errors, this `json/tests.rs` is specific to the JSON emitter and checks how spans are converted into JSON byte, line, and column positions.
